about: Sentence Scramble sentences per level. The game shows the words as shuffled tiles (commas and the end mark hidden; the first word in lower case unless keepCap is true). M.1: 5-7 words, past simple. M.2: 8-10 words, past continuous and linking words. M.3: 11-14 words, relative clauses and conditionals. Written for Kru.

sentences.text: I played football with my friends.
She went to the market yesterday.
We watched a film last night.
My dad cooked rice for dinner.
They visited their grandmother on Sunday.
He didn't finish his homework.
Did you see the elephant?
The cat slept on my bed.
I bought a new bag yesterday.
We swam in the sea last summer.
She drank a glass of milk.
My brother broke the window.
Where did you go last weekend?
The teacher gave us a test.
I woke up at six o'clock.
They ate noodles at the canteen.
It rained all day on Monday.
We didn't go to school yesterday.
Tom rode his bike to school.
What did you have for breakfast?
I was watching TV when my mum came home.
While we were swimming, it started to rain.
She was reading a book, but her brother was sleeping.
They were playing football when the bell rang.
It was raining, so we stayed in the hotel.
What were you doing at eight o'clock last night?
We were walking on the beach when we saw dolphins.
Although it was hot, we were climbing the mountain.
My dad was driving while my sister was singing loudly.
I was sleeping when my phone suddenly rang.
Because the bus was late, we waited for an hour.
They were eating dinner when the lights went out.
She was taking photos while we were buying souvenirs.
Were you sleeping when I called you last night?
We were going to Phuket when the car broke down.
I wasn't listening, so I didn't hear the question.
The children were laughing because the clown fell over.
While I was cooking, my brother was cleaning the kitchen.
If I had more free time, I would learn to play the guitar.
The girl who sits next to me is the best singer in our class.
If it rains tomorrow, we will watch a film instead of playing football.
This is the restaurant where my family celebrated my grandmother's birthday last year.
I would travel around the world if I won the lottery.
The phone that I bought last month has already stopped working.
If you heat ice, it melts and turns into water very quickly.
My uncle, who lives in Bangkok, works as a doctor at a hospital.
If she had studied harder, she would have passed the exam.
The book which you lent me was more interesting than the film.
What would you do if you saw a ghost in your bedroom?
Students who use their phones in class will have to stay after school.
If we don't protect the forests, many animals will lose their homes.
The town where I grew up has changed a lot since then.
I wouldn't eat that fish if I were you, because it smells strange.
The man whose car was stolen yesterday called the police immediately.
Unless you hurry, you will miss the last bus home tonight.
The festival that we went to was crowded but really fun.
